normalization: maximum Cartesian atomic displacement equals amplitude
rep7_pattern: u7 = [0, -0.217, +0.450] pattern on Te11/12/15/16 only (anti-phase z, interlayer dipole)
curvature_definition: K = (F(+u) - F(-u)).dhat / (2 * amplitude); dhat = unit vector along mode
mass_weighted_com_direction_note: COM of raw (non-mass-weighted) eigenvector is zero; mode is COM-conserving
